🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Great things to do around Tesoro Highlands this weekend.

🎨 *Fri* — Sticks and Stones: Nature Art Exhibition (free)
   Free art show all weekend, great for families
🥕 *Sat 8:30 AM* — Old Town Newhall Farmers Market (free)
   Fresh local produce and crafts, kids love it
🦘 *Sun* — Visit The Gentle Barn (from $15)
   See animals up close, perfect Sunday activity
🎸 *Fri 4 PM* — Loud @ the Library: Powered by Music Lab 🎸 (free)
   Free live music at the library Friday evening
😂 *Sat 8 PM* — The Society Comedy Troupe ($22.23)
   Local comedy troupe Saturday night, adults only
🎵 *Sun 1 PM* — Afternoon Acoustic Jam (free)
   Laid-back acoustic jam Sunday afternoon

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
